about.purpose: Mihrab reduces distractions and helps you build a daily routine of prayer, Quran, remembrance and learning.
about.description: Mihrab helps you prepare for prayer with prayer times, adhan, hadith, Quran reading and lessons. The app works locally and has no commercial ads.
about.features: Mihrab includes prayer times, hadith with commentary, Quran routines, adhkar and lessons. Set custom reminders in Notifications.
about.localPrivacy: Mihrab keeps your data on your device. Local features work offline, with no cloud account, ads or tracking from Mihrab.
about.localStorage: Settings, Quran progress, saved hadith and videos, and data usage stay on your device. Mihrab has no cloud account and does not send this data to our servers. We add no ads or tracking.
about.mobilePrivacy: Settings, Quran routine progress and saved content stay on your phone. Location is not determined from your IP address. Downloading new content or opening a video or external link connects to the service provider, whose policies apply.
about.thirdParty: Third-party services such as YouTube and prayer-time or location providers may collect connection data under their own policies. We do not control their tracking practices.
about.noncommercial: The full source code is available for study, use, modification, and redistribution for noncommercial purposes, while adhering to Islamic guidelines, and neither the project nor any derivative version may be used as a means of earning or profit.
about.hadithCredit: Hadith and commentary come from HadeethEnc.com. Publisher credits, sources and links are retained. The scholarly content belongs to its credited sources.
about.offline: Calculate prayer times and read Quran routines, hadith and saved content offline. New content, official verification and external video need internet. Notifications depend on Android permissions and battery settings.
about.prayerTimes: Prayer times may vary by city, calculation method and authority. Check your region settings and source when needed. Network, performance and accessibility settings control usage and readability.
about.support: Allah willing, support received by Mihrab will be spent exclusively on developing this project. Support is entirely optional and does not affect access to app features.
report.privacy: Review your report before opening the external service to submit it with your account. Mihrab does not send reports directly or collect logs or device data automatically.
report.describe: What did you do? What happened? What did you expect?
report.review: Describe what happened and review what you want to share.

about.desktopDescription: Mihrab is a desktop app for organizing your time and preparing for prayer. It includes prayer times, adhan, a preparation screen, hadith, Quran routines and daily lessons. It provides a calm space for worship without ads or commercial services.
about.quranSource: The Quranic text in Hafs from Asim and Warsh from Nafi comes from resources published by the King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex. Verse-position data organize the Quran routines and their boundaries. We make no claim that the publisher endorses the app’s assembly or its divisions. The Quranic script and its rendering accuracy may vary across screens and devices. Please report errors through Report a Bug for review and correction.
about.terms: The project terms apply to the original code owned by its developer. Rights to external libraries, fonts and sources remain with their respective holders. Their licenses and notices must be respected.

ui.ce5a582d9219fd69: Mihrab is a waqf on behalf of my grandfather, may Allah have mercy on him. I dedicate the reward of this work to him, hoping Allah will benefit him through it. update.release103.title: What’s new from 1.0.2 to 1.0.3?
update.release103.sync: Added local sync between phone and computer, with data source selection on first sync and protocol compatibility verification.
update.release103.reader: Improved Wird Mushaf display and line justification, with fixes for page clipping in some languages and faster preparation of adjacent pages.
update.release103.feedback: Added a categorized report form that prepares details for Google Forms and GitHub.
update.release103.locales: Reviewed interface translations, religious terminology, and surah names, and hid the Muhaddith field when absent from the source.
update.release103.lessons: Fixed channel name display, lesson numbering, and the layout of batch navigation buttons.
update.release103.performance: Reduced visual effects in Economy mode, and improved caching and batching of UI work.
update.release103.notifications: Resolved duplicate notification scheduling and improved the display of sync failure messages.
update.release103.android: Added fullscreen reading and page swiping, improved older WebView compatibility, and hid unavailable hardware options.
